notes.title: New Project Reveal: Crimson System — VɅΔ Protocol
notes.content:
Crimson System: VɅΔ Protocol — First Look

AN AI‑REIMAGINED RETRO FPS  
You wake in glowing stasis capsules. Footsteps echo in the dark. Somewhere on this station, something is hungry.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10584768/a9043eb2d2e538a46002b607b8203e8c0a42eb33.jpg"]

Hi, I'm Slamert, a solo developer.   I've always wanted to build a classic shooter, but the scope felt impossible — until AI tools arrived. So I began an experiment: one human + neural networks.

Every sprite, texture, model and sound was born in a dialogue with AI, then hand‑polished in Godot Engine

No premade assets — just carbon and silicon neurons working together

The result is a fast, dark, 90s‑flavoured FPS with 2D sprites in full 3D levels  
Why this matters
If you miss straightforward old‑school shooters — or you’re curious where this experiment leads — please add the game to your wishlist. It helps a ton!
